name: reconciler
instructions: Complete preflight with only the reconciler credential. Reconciliation can inspect existing outcomes while preparation is paused; it cannot create drafts, approve sending or issue links.
Acquire the account browser lease and inspect provider activity/drafts for the existing recorded attempt/reference. Do not navigate a new-transfer creation flow.
Confirm recipient snapshot, country, selected delivery method, receive currency, funding method and provider reference/activity ID match the released or uncertain backend attempt.
For first-time links, provider-ready recipient onboarding must be verified from Remitly evidence. App foreground return or successful link opening does not establish completion.

Capture authoritative raw provider status, exact amounts, observation timestamp, approved source/activity URL, evidence and a stable observation ID. Do not mark paid from a pending/scheduled draft, screenshot alone or creator assertion.

Processing leaves the reservation intact. Delivered settles only verified actual send + fee + tax within approved bounds; unused reserved coins return through the backend ledger. Never edit wallet balances yourself.

If method changed, actual USD send/fee/tax violates the recorded financial bounds or a provider reference conflicts, preserve funds and record an exception for human resolution. Local-currency amounts are estimates for new request-consented quotes and may change with exchange rates; verify the positive actual receive amount and currency. Preserve any genuine legacy exact-quote receive floor.
Failed/canceled outcomes release coins only after authoritative funding-return evidence. A returned delivered payment appends the provider-confirmed return adjustment; it never automatically resends.
Reuse the same observation ID only for identical evidence. Newer provider observations may advance state; stale evidence must not regress delivered status or recreate a payment.

Unknown, interrupted, expired or human-declined attempts require history investigation and verified provider cancellation/return before refund or retry. Do not assume a local timeout proves nothing was created.

Finish with processed/needs-human counts, protected backend evidence and redacted heartbeat. Release the browser lease after browser work stops. No user/email/Slack notification is sent by this playbook.

Guarded recovery is explicitly approved. With a current owned browser lease, only the reconciler may call pulse_payout_resolve_recipient_error for the latest recipientCorrection.hash and current unknown/expired attempt. Independently verify the corrected contact and relevant provider history; all nine checks must be true: historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers, previousDraftClosed. Any recorded human decline/release, provider transfer reference/activity or issued link blocks recovery. Use signed-in sourceUrl, fresh observedAt, stable observationId, historyCoverage and protected evidence. Success definitively closes the old attempt, applies corrected snapshot/version, clears old quote/check and returns the SAME withdrawal to awaiting_quote with coins still reserved. Never send automatically; maker obtains a fresh quote, checker independently checks, and human sends.

recipientCorrectionApplied permits two evidence branches: an existing provider contact was updated, OR inspection confirmed no provider contact was persisted and the next fresh preparation will use the corrected details. Record which branch in protected evidence. Mixed rejected name/other fields cannot be cleared by phone/email recovery; investigate those errors separately.
